items.title: Albert Jiles Interview, 1961-02-24
items.q: They tell me that Piku's was the biggest but I didn't see Piku.

ctx.x: What was the biggest one you ever saw for a funeral?
Well the biggest one I saw was Silly Stan. They tell me that Piku's was the biggest but I didn't see Piku.
Did you see Chris Gellis funeral?
